title: Industry Report | Q1 2023 Global AIGC Quarterly
summary: Q1 flash. Global AIGC ¥3.811B / 17 deals; B+ share 23.53%; largest round Anthropic $400M (Google). China ¥589M / 14 deals; top Project AI 2.0 multi-ten-M USD; China avg ~¥42.1M. Only 4 global rounds >¥100M (35.29%).
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Insight / industry quarterly · April 10, 2023 · Full rewrite — not a stub

Q1 flash. Global AIGC ¥3.811B / 17 deals; B+ share 23.53%; largest round Anthropic $400M (Google). China ¥589M / 14 deals; top Project AI 2.0 multi-ten-M USD; China avg ~¥42.1M. Only 4 global rounds >¥100M (35.29%).

01.1 Global news

  • GPT-4 (Mar 15): multimodal; API + ChatGPT Plus day-one (unlike GPT-3/3.5 lag); image understanding; custom style; context 3k→25k words; accuracy/reasoning/safety leaps; 6 commercial scene demos. Bing confirmed on GPT-4. ChatGPT API (Mar 1) on 3.5 Turbo at $0.002/1k tokens — ~90% cheaper → app boom.
  • Microsoft 365 Copilot (Mar 17): GPT-4 + Graph across Word / PowerPoint / Excel / Outlook / Teams / Power Platform; Business Chat aggregates docs, mail, calendar, notes, contacts. Flow: prompt → Graph context → GPT-4 → Graph compliance.
  • Microsoft GDC: 33 sessions on speed, acquisition/retention, tech/culture, productivity; AI art/score for game cost-down; GPT NPCs for mid-core monetization.
  • Google Bard public test (US/UK, gradual, text-first) as search “collaborator” not replacement; Workspace generative AI + PaLM API.
  • Adobe Firefly; Meta LLaMA; NVIDIA DGX Cloud with GCP / Azure / OCI.

01.2 China

Baidu ERNIE Bot launch; Aliyun AIGC infrastructure push; Visual China first AIGC product on VCG.com. Industry map cross-ref in CN §1.3.

02 Markets

Secondary: AIGC concept index +59.24% Q1 (Tonghuashun). Media index 1,874→2,389 (+27.48%) — Zhewen Interconnect (+32.43% YTD, exploring virtual-human “birth/raise/educate”), CITIC Press, Tianxiaxiu, ChineseAll. Compute names QingCloud, CapInfo, Cambricon hit limit-ups / >10% days on ChatGPT training demand.

Primary: Anthropic $400M strategic (Google; Claude internal test; prior A $124M, FTX-led $580M; ~$5B valuation). Typeface $65M A (Lightspeed / GV / M12 / Menlo) — enterprise brand-safe generative content (CEO Abhay Parasnis). CB Insights: ~110 ChatGPT-related VC deals in 2022 (>$2.6B); ~250 startups (33% unfunded, 51% ≤A); unicorns OpenAI $20B, Hugging Face $2B, Lightricks $1.8B, Jasper $1.5B, Glean & Stability AI $1B.

7 CN images; Xenniu methodology/disclaimer. Attach on ingest.

— END —
